name: Pizza Pub
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizza Pub in Füssen**

Welcome to **Pizza Pub** in **Füssen**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the cozy charm of the **Allgäu** region. Just a short stroll from the picturesque **Schloss Neuschwanstein**, our rustic yet modern pub offers a relaxed atmosphere perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s breathtaking landscapes.

Our menu features **Pizza** baked in a traditional wood-fired oven, with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a vegetarian **Funghi**, every slice is crafted with care. Pair your meal with a cold **Radler**, a crisp **Weißbier**, or one of our fine Italian wines.

After dinner, enjoy a selection of craft beers and cocktails while soaking in the lively yet laid-back vibe. Live music and board games add to the fun—ideal for families, groups, or solo travelers.

**Pizza Pub** is your perfect pit stop in **Füssen**, blending great food, great drinks, and great company. Come taste the difference!
